# Insurance Company - Car Insurance Landing Page

## About
This is a car insurance landing page for a Saudi Arabia-based insurance company.

## Technologies
- HTML5
- CSS3
- Vanilla JavaScript
- No frameworks or libraries

## Features
- Responsive design
- RTL support (Arabic)
- SEO optimized
- Schema markup
- Contact form with reCAPTCHA
- FAQ accordion
- Comparison table
- Countdown timer
